description: List the connected social accounts of the API key's workspace across all networks, YouTube channels, Bluesky accounts and Google Business Profile locations included (use the account id as accountId in create_post). Optional channel filter; `unavailableChannels` names networks whose accounts could not be loaded. Requires scope ACCOUNTS_READ.

channel.description: Only accounts of this network, e.g. TIKTOK (UPPERCASE canonical, lowercase accepted).

name: list_accounts
title: List accounts
